title: Codons Are Three Nucleotides
text: Each codon consists of three consecutive nucleotides and codes for one amino acid. The mRNA is read in the 5' to 3' direction during translation.

title: Start and Stop Codons
text: AUG is the universal start codon and codes for Methionine (Met). UAA, UAG, and UGA are stop codons that signal the end of translation - they do not code for any amino acid.

title: Common Codons
text: Key codons: AUG = Met (start); GCA = Ala (Alanine); UUC = Phe (Phenylalanine); AAG = Lys (Lysine); UAA = Stop.

title: Count Amino Acids
